user.title: Set up Airmee
user.description: Choose how to follow your parcels.

menu_options.account: Account (log in with your phone number)

account.title: Log in to Airmee
account.description: Airmee texts you a code. Enter your country code and phone number as you would in the Airmee app.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.description: Enter the code Airmee just sent by SMS.

tracking.title: Track by link
tracking.description: Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `airmee.track_parcel` service. Airmee ties each tracking link to the recipient's phone number hash, so enter yours here.

reconfigure.title: Update the phone number hash
reconfigure.description: Enter the recipient's phone number hash again.

error.invalid_phone_number: Airmee did not accept that phone number.

abort.already_configured: This Airmee source is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Airmee account than the one being re-authenticated.

data_description.add: Enter an Airmee tracking code to start tracking it. You find it on the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery card.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like an Airmee tracking code.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Airmee tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Airmee tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Airmee tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
